(1) one can usually obtain equivalent training and test set learning curves for deep neural networks by simply increasing the batch size, (2) this can be done without changing the learning rate, momentum, weight decay, or any other hyper-parameter, and (3) the same procedure can be applied to SGD with momentum, RMSprop, and Adam.

It is common practice to decrease the learning rate during training. However, we show that one can usually obtain equivalent learning curves on both training and validation sets by instead increasing batch size during training."
